ceu: ✦ The sextile between the Moon and Saturn at {H:1820863183000}

s.k: Share a dream with someone who believes in it.
t: A day to feel part of something bigger. Call someone you have not spoken to in a while.

The sextile between the Moon and Saturn brings together, in your favour, friendships and your image: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Accept whatever help comes along, wherever it comes from.
s.d: Share a project of yours with someone who can help.

s.k: Your goals ask for a firm step.
t: The Moon passes through your area of career and puts your goals in plain sight. Show what you are capable of.

The sextile between the Moon and Saturn brings together, in your favour, your career and your inner life: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. It is a good moment to bring the two together in a single plan.
s.d: Ask for an honest opinion from someone you respect.

s.k: A day to learn and broaden your horizons.
t: Today faith and optimism grow stronger. A book, an inspiring conversation or a travel plan will do you good.

The sextile between the Moon and Saturn brings together, in your favour, your horizons and friendships: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Use this good energy to sort out what had stalled.
s.d: Write down where you want to be a year from now.

s.k: Trust is the word of the day.
t: With the Moon in your house of sharing, matters of joint money or of trust call for clarity.

The sextile between the Moon and Saturn brings together, in your favour, intimacy and your career: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Doors open more easily when you ask clearly.
s.d: End the day with a minute of gratitude for what has changed in you.

s.k: Today the other person is your mirror.
t: The Moon shows you, in others, what you need to see in yourself. A day of lessons shared by two.

The sextile between the Moon and Saturn brings together, in your favour, relationships and your horizons: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. An idea from today could become a real project.
s.d: Give a sincere compliment to your partner or to a close friend.

s.k: Organise the day and the day will organise you.
t: It is a day of service and usefulness: helping someone at work also helps you.

The sextile between the Moon and Saturn brings together, in your favour, routine and intimacy: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Trust what you are building: today the sky lends a hand.
s.d: Swap a snack for fruit and notice how you feel.

s.k: Your heart wants a celebration and a little light.
t: The Moon passes through your area of pleasure and creativity. Allow yourself to do something just because you enjoy it.

The sextile between the Moon and Saturn brings together, in your favour, romance and relationships: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Smile more: kindness opens paths today.
s.d: Dance at home, even if it is just to one song.

s.k: The heart of the day is at home.
t: Today your heart pulls you indoors. A quiet dinner or some tidying at home will do you good.

The sextile between the Moon and Saturn brings together, in your favour, family and routine: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. A small gesture can have a big effect today.
s.d: Open the windows in the morning and let fresh air into your home.

s.k: One conversation can change the course of the day.
t: With the Moon in your house of communication, a word said at the right moment can clear up a misunderstanding.

The sextile between the Moon and Saturn brings together, in your favour, conversations and romance: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Be thankful for what goes well and say it out loud.
s.d: Before reacting to a message, read it twice.

s.k: Look at what you have, not at what you lack.
t: The Moon lights up what you have and what you are worth. A day to value your work and your time.

The sextile between the Moon and Saturn brings together, in your favour, money and family: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Let things flow without forcing them.
s.d: Think of a way to make one of your talents pay off.

s.k: A day to put yourself first.
t: Your sign welcomes the Moon and your mood may swing more than usual. Give yourself time and do not take everything to heart.

The sextile between the Moon and Saturn brings together, in your favour, your image and conversations: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Put your heart and your head on the same side.
s.d: Start something new today, however small.

s.k: A day to recharge on the inside.
t: The Moon passes through your most private area and asks for retreat. Slowing down today is not wasting time.

The sextile between the Moon and Saturn brings together, in your favour, your inner life and money: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. It is a day for sowing: what you do today grows over time.
s.d: Spend five minutes in silence before going to sleep.
